liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Foxy Lady Jam** (2 reviews): Listener highlights the performance of this song, contrasting it with the Viola Lee Blues; Listener describes the Jimi Hendrix jam as sounding like Purple Haze, adding extra flavor [8][11]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Reviewer questions if this is the best version, noting the first three songs were rough [14]
- **Cryptical Envelopment** (1 review): The transition to The Other One is compared to a fusion band with telepathic improvisation [18]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): Listener identifies this as one of their favorite versions of the song of all time [14]
- **Viola Lee Blues** (1 review): Performance is described as funky and raw, with Jerry riffing and Phil walking bass scales [12]

## The recordings

- **gd1969-04-21.sbd.clugston.6182.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 23 songs; 177 min; rated 3.67/5 by 9 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer praises the recording's incredible sound quality and the band's tight performance [7]
- **gd1969-04-21.sbd.miller.88465.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 153 min; rated 4.33/5 by 12 [2]. Said about its sound: Audio flaws were cleaned up, and the tape runs out during the Feedback section [2]
- **gd69-04-21.sbd.bertha-ashley.19841.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 147 min; rated 4.37/5 by 35 [5]. Said about its sound: Sound is described as superb, though the end of the Feedback section is cut short; Sound quality is noted as quite good, though it contains a small amount of hiss; Reviewer describes the mix as perfect, noting Phil's bass is huge in the recording [9][11][16]
- **gd1969-04-21.sbd.ashley.89717.vobf**: soundboard; 0 songs; 0 min [6]

## Around the show

- Reviewer claims the Winterland show from October 25, 1969, is even better than this one [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1969-04-21.sbd.clugston.6182.shnf**: transferred by Scott Clugston; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Transfer lineage is MSR to DAT to CDR, sourced from Scott Clugston and Lee Revell [1]
- **gd1969-04-21.sbd.miller.88465.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> CD D [2]
- **gd69-04-21.sbd.bertha-ashley.19841.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller and J. Ashley; source: Soundboard - Bertha Remaster [5]
- **gd1969-04-21.sbd.ashley.89717.vobf**: transferred by Jay Ashley; source: Bertha Remaster of the patched Master Reel source 88465. [6]. Also: Digitally remastered in January 2007 using Bertha DAW, with patches showing multiple analog generations [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead The Ark, Boston Poster Apr. '69](https://www.dead.net/archives/1969/artwork/ark-boston-poster-apr-69) [20]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead The Ark - April 21, 1969](https://www.dead.net/show/april-21-1969) [21]
